title: Save select
idea: Save select: Named slots and last-played context lead load or overwrite review
audience: People who need to load game within a game surface.
avoidWhen: Slots have no reliable state identity
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic timeline layout through its load game priority and explicit commitment contract: Overwrite requires confirmation and preserves recovery where supported
navigation: Save select keeps the current load game context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Named slots and last-played context lead load or overwrite review
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to load game; players choose recoverable progress states
composition.priority: Overwrite requires confirmation and preserves recovery where supported

imagery.role: Support the actual load game context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep overwrite visually separate from load
Compose for safe zones, aspect ratio and the actual input device; preserve world readability.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the save select structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no load game content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Overwrite requires confirmation and preserves recovery where supported
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized load game content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Overwrite requires confirmation and preserves recovery where supported
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active load game context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure frame-time and input latency in the real engine; DOM checks cannot certify in-world UI.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
